This '''Aing-Tii translation device''' was created by the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Species/Legends|species]] for help with communicating with other species, since the Aing-Tii communicated through the use of [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]]. This [[Electronic translator/Legends|electronic translator]] could analyze the pheromones produced by an Aing-Tii and translate them into words in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|basic]], and vice-versa. [[Tadar'Ro]]'s personal translation device was programmed with the voice of [[Jorj Car'das]].
